summary: Frontend-only test of the layered Shred City stage (/#/shred-legend) at 1920x800, 1920x1080, 1280x800, 844x390 and 667x375, plus a Main Stage regression check. Everything requested works. The stage renders 23 imgs, none broken, with all 8 lamps (shred-lamp-0..7). The intro card is usable. Between songs every prop tap works on the intro and result screens: amps, marshall, wedges, lamps and curtains. During a song all lamps are disabled and all 6 tap buttons are removed from the DOM. --kick and --ph change every frame and follow the beat: ph rises 0.12->0.98, wraps around, and kick peaks about 0.67 just after ph resets. Beam opacity grows with the meter: 0.20 on intro, then 0.30, 0.42, 0.50, 0.61, 0.70 and 0.74 as the meter goes 0->73% (Headliner). The crowd meter has a dark backdrop (rgba(10,20,32,0.72)) and is readable over the lamps. On phone landscape (844x390 and 667x375): .shred-rig is display:none, shred-beams are visible, and the meter, guitar, Bend button and side crowds are all inside the viewport with no scroll. A full song runs to the result card. Pick Song returns to the intro. Random (shred-again-btn) starts a new countdown, as the code intends. /#/rank-hall renders with 0 broken images and no shred-stage. No page errors.

design_issues.screen: Shred City desktop, wide or short (1920x800, 1920x1080)
issues: The .shred-art layer is top-anchored at width max(100vw, 100dvh*1.49), so at 16:9 or wider the bottom of the art is cut off. At 1920x800 the wedge monitors (shred-tap-wedge-left/right) are completely off screen (top=970px), so they cannot be tapped. At 1920x1080 they span y 971-1215, so only the top ~110px shows. The phone-landscape media query already centers the art vertically. Consider bottom-anchoring or centering the art on desktop too, so the floor and wedges stay visible.

The centers of the amp and marshall tap targets sit under the intro card (shred-song-4 / shred-song-picker). Users can still tap the visible edges, but most of those props are hidden behind the card. Low priority.
The 'Garage Band' tier title (lowest tier) is grey-blue on the dark navy card, so its contrast is low. Minor.
The SHRED CITY title pill covers lamp-3, so its center is not tappable. Cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: anchor or center .shred-art vertically on desktop so the wedge monitors and floor are visible at 16:9 and wider (they are off screen at 1920x800).
critical_code_review_comments: ShredStage play() creates a new Audio on every tap with no throttle. Rapid tapping stacks sounds. Consider reusing one Audio per sound.
The rAF loop in ShredStage runs forever, even when the stage is not active (it writes --kick=0 every frame). Consider stopping it when !active and hitRef is about 0.
Asset paths are relative ('assets/shred/'). That works with the hash router, but other pages use process.env.PUBLIC_URL. Keep this consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (with minor design notes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: page.goto to the same hash URL does not reset an in-progress song. Use reload or a fresh context. Force-clicking prop tap targets on phone can fall through to song buttons under the intro card and start a song (amps center is under shred-song-4 at 667x375). Beam opacity is the computed opacity of '[data-testid=shred-beams] > div > div'. Dispatching pointerdown/up on guitar-note-i every 312ms during Garage Stomp fills the meter to about 73% in 25s.
